title: ELITE LONGSHOT GLINT
why: His 10-28 yes to #5: a 272 damage elite Longshot shot needs a half-second warning. A growing white muzzle star with a red core and the machine charge sound precede player-directed shots in chase and at the extraction ring. The star draws above fog only on a clear line to the local player. Both windows use ninth-field bit 4; burn, get-up and other shared bits stay intact. Aim and cooldown draws keep their order; cooldown repays the warning time. No new switch or player text. Watch in play: the glint must read at range in the smooth look and at night; revealing a hidden Longshot pillager must not feel like a wallhack; Longshot pillagers should lose more duels because players can dodge.
now: Elite Longshot shots have a half-second muzzle glint in both windows.
